description: Co. Offaly Road Network is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Offaly County Council. The roads schedule lists all roads in charge of Offaly County Council, giving details of the road numbers, street names and lengths. The spatial data is normally the centre line of the road. Coverage: Offaly County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Offaly County Council. Its tags are offaly, road, road network, traffic infrastructure, transport. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
